title: Add maintenance mode to effectively disable the live app

requirements.text: Add a frontend-configurable "maintenance mode" that, when enabled, prevents normal app usage and displays a full-page maintenance message instead of the main application UI (header, hero, main content, footer).
acceptanceCriteria: A new environment variable is documented in frontend/.env.example (e.g., VITE_MAINTENANCE_MODE) with guidance on accepted values.
When maintenance mode is enabled, the app renders a maintenance screen and does not render the normal application content (HeroSection/MainContent) or show authentication actions.
The maintenance screen user-facing text is in English and clearly indicates the app is temporarily unavailable.
When maintenance mode is disabled/unset, the app behaves exactly as it did before the change.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing or integrating any platform-level deployment cancellation or CI/CD pipeline controls.
Adding third-party status pages, notifications, or external service integrations.
